label: The Designer
tagline: A wireframe that lets you read the seams between intent and artifact.
cluster_explainer: The Auditor cluster wants the engine to remain unfinished and legible — it leaves forever the moment the seams are hidden.
demo_highlights: Grid preset lays bare the underlying coordinate system — every line is a token a designer can point at and audit
Icosahedron exposes its facets: edges read like type cuts, so a designer can critique geometry the way they would a typeface
Treble-dominant reactor highlights the fine edges and transient hits where design decisions are most legible
Step envelope forces clear ON/OFF state transitions — the seams between idle and reactive states are visible, not smoothed away
No shader blur, no bloom: the demo is a wireframe of the engine itself, exactly the rough-edge tolerance the designer typology demands
